summary: If Y=M+sqrt(T)G and E[T^(-1/2)]<=sqrt(2*pi), then P(Y in [0,1])<=2 Phi(sqrt(pi/2))-1=0.789908594556... sharply. Hence the class remains at TV distance at least 0.210091405443... from Uniform[0,1] and is not weakly dense in the cap-one laws. Product separation is at least 1-alpha^n from Uniform([0,1]^n). This blocks only Gaussian-mixture approximation plus weak-closure under the preserved inverse-scale hypothesis; it is not a QFORM counterexample.
